description: This Go source file implements a resource discovery handler for Kubernetes API server, managing API group versions, priorities, caching, and serving the /apis endpoint for aggregated API resource discovery.

classes.name: resourceManager
classes.description: Implements ResourceManager interface, managing API group versions and serving discovery endpoint.

classes.name: resourceDiscoveryManager
classes.description: Handles internal logic for managing API groups, versions, priorities, caching, and HTTP serving.

methods.name: AddGroupVersion
methods.description: Adds or updates a group version in the discovery manager.

methods.name: SetGroupVersionPriority
methods.description: Sets priority for a specific group version.

methods.name: RemoveGroup
methods.description: Removes all versions of a specified group.

methods.name: SetGroups
methods.description: Replaces the current list of API groups with a new list.

methods.name: WithSource
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceManager with a different source.

methods.name: AddInvalidationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for cache invalidation.

methods.name: fetchFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached API group list or regenerates it if absent.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for the discovery endpoint.
